title: RoadProfileTemplate
description: A road cross-section template extracted from civil CAD linework. Features are listed from centerline outward (ascending offset). Agents use these to generate offset curves or 3D road surfaces from a centerline alignment.

description.description: Free-text description of the road type

source.description: Provenance — where this template was extracted from

chainage.description: Station along centerline where cross-section was sampled (m)

symmetric.description: True if all features appear on both sides. When true, every feature is mirrored. When false, each feature specifies whether it appears on both sides or one side only.

features.description: Cross-section features ordered from centerline outward. Each entry defines a boundary at a given offset. For symmetric roads, features are listed once and mirrored. For asymmetric roads, each feature declares its placement.

width.description: Width of the zone between this feature and the previous one (m)

bilateral.description: True if this feature appears on both sides (default). False if it appears on one side only — which side is determined at application time by the agent based on context.

layerMap.description: Maps CAD layer name patterns to feature types. Keys are layer substrings, values are feature type strings.
